summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the iteration_3 defects on /design-preview using the public URL and Playwright at 320/390/768/1024/1440. 8 of 9 targeted fixes PASS. (d) at 320 is only partly fixed: the Providers fix introduced a new overlap, and two pills still overflow. PASS: (a) More sheet on family and center at 390: opening moves focus to more-sheet-close. Tab and Shift+Tab cycle only inside the sheet over 12 presses. Escape and the close button both close it and return focus to bottom-nav-more. (b) Keyboard focus outlines are 3px solid in the requested colors: family dark rgb(92,207,219) on #151B33, family light rgb(10,115,133) on white, preview bar rgb(125,179,232) on #0B1530 in both themes, clinical rgb(15,86,146). All are at least 3:1. (c) Child tabs at 320: ArrowRight walks all 10 tabs. Every focused tab sits fully inside the strip (17..303), centered, clear of the fade and chevron. Home, End and ArrowLeft work and aria-selected follows focus. (e) Platform tabs: populated shows Pending (2)/Decided (2), empty shows (0)/(0), loading and error hide the counts. Metrics: 3/2/2/1, then 0s with empty subtitles, then '—' with 'Couldn’t load · retry below', then 4 *-loading skeletons. Returning to populated restores everything. (f) Family with page.clock set to Sat 24 Oct, Mon 26 Oct and Wed 21 Oct 23:30: family-loading skeleton seen, then content; zero console errors or warnings, no 'did not match' and no Next overlay. Weekend shows the rest state. (g) Family dark ErrorState: bg rgb(28,35,66), border rgb(42,50,86), text rgb(233,236,245), dark Retry button. Not pink. (h) Platform metric values at 390 share the same top/bottom per row (443/473, 593/623) even though 'Pending applications' wraps. (i) Chevrons are 44x44 (child-tabs left/right, preview-screens). The specialty switcher is now a select (child-specialty-context), so the 768 overflow is gone. REGRESSIONS STILL PASSING: dark from first paint with JS chunks blocked, via ?theme=dark and via localStorage tb-family-theme=dark (rgb(13,18,38)). theme-toggle switches, persists across reload and toggles back. Chevrons hide at scroll end; child-tabs cues show at 320/390/768 and are off at 1024/1440. h1-h3 compute to Plus Jakarta Sans on all 6 routes; p/button/select/input/li/span compute to IBM Plex Sans (except 5 decorative index card titles, as before). No horizontal overflow on 7 route variants x 5 widths. 0 console errors across those loads.

ui_bugs.issue: New overlap caused by the iteration_3 fix. The li is 'flex flex-wrap' with the name block as 'min-w-0 flex-1' (flex-basis 0). The row never wraps: the name block shrinks to 19px, 'Leila Hassan' breaks to 'Leila / Hass…' (scrollWidth 55 > clientWidth 19) and the Speech tag covers the text. At 390 the block is only 89px and the name wraps onto 2 lines. Fix: give the name block a real basis (e.g. 'basis-[9rem] grow' or 'min-w-[9rem]'), or put the tags in their own wrapping div that drops to a full-width line on small screens.

The 'Not yet observed this month' Pill (whitespace-nowrap) in goal-g3's 'flex gap-2' row is 21px wider than the card's content box. It sits on the card's right border (span right 287 vs card right 283). It shows in both the Overview and Goals panels. Fix: add flex-wrap to the pill row, or allow the pill to wrap/truncate.

The 'Frozen · awaiting authorized review' caution Pill in the Home plan v2 row is 9px past the li's content box and touches the right border. Fix: allow wrapping or truncate the pill (max-w-full, whitespace-normal).

issues: Rows and emails now truncate correctly. Only the Revoke button's padding box (right 295) extends into the card padding (content edge 284). The visible text is aligned, so this is cosmetic.
The h1 is the static 'Good morning, Sara' even at 23:30 local time, while the date line is live. Consider a time-based greeting or a neutral 'Hello, Sara'. The same applies to center/therapist.
The focused tab's outline is still clipped top and bottom by the overflow-x strip (iteration_3 note, unchanged). Low priority.

action_items: Child Providers li at 320/390: give the name block a usable min width or basis so the tags wrap below it instead of crushing the name to 19px and overlapping it (MEDIUM).
Goal g3 pill row and plans 'Frozen · awaiting authorized review' pill: add flex-wrap or allow the pill to wrap/truncate so it stays inside the card at 320 (LOW).
Optional: time-aware greeting; keep the tab focus ring unclipped (e.g. py-1 on the strip or a negative outline-offset).
critical_code_review_comments: Mixing 'flex-wrap' with 'flex-1 min-w-0' (basis 0%) means wrapping never happens, because the flex item can always shrink to 0. Use a positive basis/min-width whenever wrapping is the intended fallback. This affects child/page.tsx line 77.
Pill uses whitespace-nowrap everywhere. In narrow flex rows without flex-wrap it causes overflow. Consider 'max-w-full truncate' as the Pill default.

The AppShell more-sheet trap listens on the sheet element only. That's fine while focus stays inside, but a pointer click outside the sheet into the page would bypass it. An outside-click close or the inert attribute on the rest of the page would make it robust.

success_rate.frontend: ~94% (8/9 targeted fixes pass; all regression checks pass; 1 MEDIUM + 2 LOW layout defects at 320)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Base https://therabridge.preview.emergentagent.com/design-preview. Data state select: [data-testid=preview-data-state] (populated/loading/empty/error). Clock mocking with page.clock.set_fixed_time now produces no hydration errors. Inner-card overflow check: for each padded or bordered container, compare descendant rect.right to container.right - paddingRight - borderRight, skipping descendants inside overflow containers. Remaining hits at 320: goal-g3 pill (+21), plans li pill (+9), invite-revoke (+12, cosmetic). Providers crush: measure li div.min-w-0 width (19px at 320). Specialty switcher replaced by select child-specialty-context.
rca of the issue: Providers overlap: className 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3' on li with child 'min-w-0 flex-1'. flex-1 sets flex-basis 0 and min-w-0 removes the min-content floor, so all items fit on one line and the text block shrinks to the leftover 19px. The tags are whitespace-nowrap and don't shrink, and the wrapped name overflows under them. Pills: nowrap content in a non-wrapping flex row is wider than the 246px content box at 320.
